hydro.channels.method: least-cost breach (<= 300 m) of depressions >= 1 m outside waterbodies (human water rewilded: not held as ponds, routed on terrain/dem_rewilded.tif), then pysheds fill + resolve_flats, D8, NHD-seeded inflow

client.channel_depth.encoding: uint8 decimetres: mean DEM on a 20 m ring minus the channel cell, clamped 0-25 m, x10; 0 off channel

geology.units.licence: public domain (USGS SGMC) via Macrostrat, CC-BY 4.0

client.geology.encoding: R = geology unit index (geology/classes.json units; 0 none), G = rock class index (1-based into rock_classes)

client.soils.encoding: R = soil map unit index (soils/classes.json; 0 none), G = surface rock fragments % 0-100, B = depth to bedrock dm (255 = none or unknown)

client.outcrop.formula: outcrop = clip(resistance[rock_class] * shallowness * terrain * (1 - tree_cover_pct/100 * 0.5) * lidar, 0, 1); shallowness = clip((150 - depth_to_bedrock_cm) / (150 - 25), 0, 1) (0 where depth unknown); terrain = min(slope_deg / 35, 1) + 0.5 * clip(TPI_m / 1.5, 0, 1), TPI = z - mean(z, 150 m window) on the DEM averaged to 30 m; tree cover from LANDFIRE EVC; water = 0; lidar = 0.5 + min(roughness_m / 0.12, 1.5), roughness = 30 m mean of terrain/roughness_10m.tif (std of the 1 m lidar DEM about a quadratic fitted per 10 m cell)

hydro.human_water.rule: human: NHD FType 436; OSM water=reservoir/basin/wastewater or landuse=reservoir/basin; an OSM dam within 25 m (line) or 80 m (NID point); or a pond under 1.5 ha whose ring is straight (>= 12 m, RMS <= 0.12 of its length) at its outlet with ground >= 1.5 m below the water 15-45 m beyond it (on a creek >= 5 km2: RMS <= 0.08, >= 2 m). Everything else kept.

terrain.dem_rewilded.modification: terrain/dem.tif with a thalweg carved through each rewilded bed that has a channel: least-cost path down the middle of the old flat from each inflow to the outlet, lowered 0.2 m below the old water level at the inflow to 1.2 m at the outlet, parabolic 8 m wide; never raised. Routing (hydro.channels) runs on this copy; the client terrain does not show it.

client.channel_profile.encoding: RGB, row 0 north. R thalweg water depth, 2 cm units (0-5.1 m), 0 off channel; G riffle-pool index (0 deepest pool, 128 run, 255 riffle; local width = reach width x (1 + 0.15 (G/127.5 - 1))); B rewilded water: 255 former open water (meadow or wet flat), 160 riparian corridor within 12 m of the restored channel, 0 elsewhere. R and G are spread 4 px from each centreline.
client.channel_profile.depth_model: mean depth 0.10 A^0.32 m (A km2) x exp(-0.85 t), t = tanh(1.1 ln((S_local + 0.002) / (S_reach + 0.002))); S_local over max(7.5 m, 2.5 widths), S_reach over max(75 m, 10 widths), on the non-increasing DEM long profile every 2.5 m

client.species_prior.encoding: w: base64 uint8, cells x cells; w / 255 = d / (d + mean), d = usable records per 100 m cell summed over an 11 x 11 box (about 500 m radius), mean = mean of the non-zero d
client.species_prior.use: prior = 0.6 + 0.8 * w / 255 (0.6 unrecorded .. 1.4 heavily recorded); a species recorded only under licences a client may not carry is listed with a flat 0 (0.6); species with no record at all: 1 (neutral)

terrain.dem_1m.for_clients_note: pipeline only; clients read client.heights (5 m) and client.terrain_detail

terrain.dsm_1m.encoding: float32 highest non-noise return per 1 m cell (first-return surface); cells without a return take the ground
terrain.dsm_1m.for_clients_note: pipeline only (1 m, hundreds of MB)

vegetation.chm_1m.encoding: uint16 centimetres: terrain.dsm_1m - (terrain.dem_1m + median point-cloud ground offset), >= 0
vegetation.chm_1m.for_clients_note: pipeline only (1 m, hundreds of MB)

terrain.lidar_dtm_check.encoding: float32 m: mean over the 10 m cell of point-cloud ground (class 2) minus the 1 m DEM, less the median offset

vegetation.canopy_height_10m.encoding: float32 bands: 1 p95 canopy height m, 2 tree cover % (CHM >= 4 m), 3 shrub cover % (0.5 m <= CHM < 4 m); of the CHM after a 3x3 median (wires removed)

client.canopy_height.encoding: RGB, row 0 north: R p95 canopy height in 0.25 m (0-63.75 m), G tree cover % (CHM >= 4 m), B shrub cover % (0.5-4 m)

client.trees_lidar.encoding: little-endian. Header 32 bytes: magic 'WECR', u16 version 1, u16 record bytes 8, u16 cells per side (100), u16 cell metres (100), u32 crown count, f32 xy unit (0.2 m), f32 height unit (0.25 m), f32 radius unit (0.1 m), u32 0. Then u32 offsets[cells*cells + 1]: the crowns of index cell (ci = floor(x / 100), cj = floor(north / 100)) are records offsets[cj*cells + ci] .. offsets[cj*cells + ci + 1], tallest first. Then 8-byte records: u16 x, u16 north (tile metres = value * 0.2 + 0.1, north from the south edge), u8 height (* 0.25 m), u8 crown radius (* 0.1 m), u8 confidence (0-255), u8 multi-return share (0-255)
client.trees_lidar.method: local maxima of the CHM (3x3 median, gaussian sigma 1.0 m) in a square window of radius round(1 + 0.1 h) m (1-5), h >= 4.0 m; height = the median CHM's 3x3 max; crown = watershed region down to 0.5 of the peak, radius sqrt(area / pi) clipped to 0.5 .. min(2 + 0.35 h, 15) m; dropped on OSM buildings and where the multi-return share in the 5x5 around the peak is < 0.08, where the crown is narrower than max(1 m, 0.06 h) (towers, poles), and where h < 8.0 m with prominence < 2.0 m (a taller shrub in a shrub canopy). confidence = 0.35 prominence (peak minus the minimum in a square of half-width 2 w + 1 around it, w the maxima window radius, over h) + 0.25 watershed radius over h / 4 + 0.2 multi-return share over 0.6 + 0.2 height above 4 m over 6 m, each clipped to 0..1

client.terrain_detail.encoding: 8-bit grey, row 0 north, pixel centres at x = 2i + 1, north = 10000 - (2j + 1): residual m = (v - 128) * 0.04 (clamped +-5.08 m) = the 1 m DEM averaged to 2 m minus client.heights decoded and interpolated bilinearly between ITS pixel centres (x = 5i + 2.5, north = 10000 - 5j - 2.5). Linear, so texture filtering interpolates it

terrain.roughness.encoding: float32: std of the 1 m DEM about its least-squares quadratic within the 10 m cell

seasons.s2_monthly.encoding: float32 per calendar month, bands red green blue (surface reflectance 0..1) and NDVI; median over all clear looks of all years; NaN where no look

method.fill: pixels under min_looks (or a whole refused month) take the mean of the nearest months either side with enough looks

layout.order: month m (1-12) at column (m-1) % 4, row (m-1) // 4, rows top to bottom; each frame north-up on the tile grid, pixel centres as other client rasters

client.season_rgb.encoding: RGB = 255 * sRGB_encode(clamp(surface reflectance / 0.35, 0, 1)) of bands B04 B03 B02: sampled as an sRGB texture, the linear value times 0.35 is reflectance

layout.order: month m (1-12) at column (m-1) % 4, row (m-1) // 4, rows top to bottom; each frame north-up on the tile grid, pixel centres as other client rasters

client.season_ndvi.encoding: grey byte = 255 * (NDVI - (-0.2)) / 1.1, clamped: 0 = NDVI -0.2, 255 = 0.9; NDVI = (B08 - B04) / (B08 + B04), median of per-look NDVI

client.texture_ground.method: crowns (CHM >= 3 m over >= 0.3 of a pixel, +1 px) and their shadow lobes (h cot(sun elevation) toward azimuth + 180, +-5 deg, sun hour fitted per 5 km quadrant, kept where 12% darker than clean ground of the class), +2 px of dark neighbours, +1 px feather; filled by quilting 12 px patches from the nearest clean windows of the habitat class, low frequencies (sigma 20 m) set to a multi-scale normalised convolution of the class's clean ground (15, 60, 250, 1000 m)
client.texture_ground.encoding: NAIP 2022 RGB as client.texture_imagery with tree crowns and their shadows replaced by synthesized ground of the same class and season; JPEG q88

client.texture_ground_mask.encoding: 8-bit grey, row 0 north: share of the 10 m pixel replaced in client/texture_ground.jpg (255 all filled, 0 all photo; the 1 px feather counts half)

client.weather.credit: Weather data by Open-Meteo.com (https://open-meteo.com), CC BY 4.0
client.weather.clock: local wall-clock time from UTC via zoneinfo; DST days padded/trimmed to 24 rows (the skipped spring-forward hour repeats the row before it, the repeated fall-back hour keeps its first)
client.weather.encoding: compact JSON; days keyed by local date YYYY-MM-DD; per day sunrise / sunset 'HH:MM', tmax / tmin deg C, precip_mm (the local day's hours), and hourly: 24 rows (index = local wall-clock hour) of `fields`; null = no value. Clock: see `clock`; utc_offset_seconds is standard time. Units: temp_c deg C, humidity %, precip_mm / rain_mm mm in the hour, snow_cm cm fallen in the hour, snow_depth_m m on the ground, cloud* % cover, wind_kmh / gust_kmh km/h at 10 m, wind_dir deg the wind comes from, code WMO weather code

stats_rules.snow_days: snowfall summed over the day >= 0.5 cm

footprint.urban.encoding: uint8, row 0 north: 1 densely built (streets, blocks and street trees rewilded whole), 0 not
footprint.urban.method: OSM building cover (rasterised at 2.5 m) averaged within 100 m; dense where >= 0.15, or >= 0.075 on LANDFIRE EVT Developed-Medium / High Intensity cells; kept within 25 m of a building or on those cells; closed by 40 m, enclosed gaps under 3 ha filled, components under 75 ha dropped
